verdict.rationale: The firm documents a dedicated IP practice and team whose page lists trademarks among the matters it covers. However, this is a single combined IP page with no distinct trademark or brand team, and it does not describe trademark clearance, registration, or enforcement work. Missing for 10: a dedicated trademark/brand practice or team, documented clearance searches, registration/prosecution services, brand enforcement or anti-counterfeiting work, and independent corroboration.
